title: Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) Reimbursement Unit Valuation Terms
content:
Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) values every reimbursed unit at the declared unit cost on the latest inbound receipt of the SKU, up to a per-unit maximum set by program.

| Program | Per-unit value basis | Maximum reimbursement value per unit (USD) | Reimbursement reversed when the reimbursed units are later found and returned to inventory |
|---|---|---|---|
| FBN Starter Program | declared unit cost on the latest inbound receipt of the SKU | 500.00 | yes |
| FBN Core Program | declared unit cost on the latest inbound receipt of the SKU | 500.00 | yes |
| FBN Growth Program | declared unit cost on the latest inbound receipt of the SKU | 750.00 | yes |
| FBN Scale Program | declared unit cost on the latest inbound receipt of the SKU | 1000.00 | yes |
| FBN Premier Program | declared unit cost on the latest inbound receipt of the SKU | 2000.00 | yes |
| FBN Enterprise Program | declared unit cost on the latest inbound receipt of the SKU | 5000.00 | yes |

## Reading the table

- The per-unit value is the declared unit cost or the maximum of the program, whichever is lower.
- Example (hypothetical costs): a SKU whose latest inbound receipt declares 820.00 USD per unit is valued at 750.00 USD per unit in FBN Growth Program and at 820.00 USD per unit in FBN Scale Program, where the maximum is 1000.00 USD.
